name: Boom Festival

location.venue_or_area: Herdade da Granja (Boomland), on the Marechal Carmona reservoir

attendance.note: Press-reported: all 40,000 tickets sold for 2025. Organiser says 2025 sold out in 48 hours without a line-up, its 7th consecutive sell-out, with Boomers from 165 countries. Organiser notes its total headcount also includes staff, artists and volunteers.

audience.psychographics: International psychedelic and transformational festival community (165 countries in 2025); counterculture, sustainability and art minded, anti-corporate by policy.

ticket_price.note: 2027 pricing not yet published; ticket portal on the festival site. A free-entry Boomland open day has also been run.

vibe.rationale: Deep, community-trusted, heavily curated multi-format culture, but 40,000 scale and a strict no-sponsor, no-logo policy fail the brand-friendly trait.

fit_notes: Strong wellness and consciousness adjacency and a global audience, but Boom takes no sponsors, logos or corporate backing, so a branded activation is effectively off the table; only vendor stall space is sold.
